title: Before I Go to Sleep
author: S. J. Watson
summary: Each morning Christine wakes with no memory of the last twenty years, and has to be told who her husband is. A secret journal and a doctor she is not supposed to know about begin to show her a different version of her life.
readIf: you like claustrophobic thrillers built around a narrator who cannot trust her own memory.
skipIf: you want a gentle read, as the story involves long-term deception and abuse.

pairings.reason: Another story of a woman with a hazy memory piecing together what happened.
A shorter psychological thriller with a similar sense of something being hidden.
